rules.name: names_after_herrn_frau
rules.description: Matches person names preceded by 'Herrn' or 'Frau', explicitly handling initials like N.R., JG, and full names with titles.

rules.name: names_in_address_context
rules.description: Matches names that appear immediately before an address pattern (street, number, postal code, city), ensuring the name is not truncated.
rules.content: (?:in der Beschwerdesache(?:\s+der)?|als Beschwerdeführerin|als Beschwerdeführer)\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)*(?:\s*,\s*(?:Bakk\.?\s+techn\.|LLM|PhD|BA|MA)\.?)?)|(?:in der Beschwerdesache(?:\s+der)?|als Beschwerdeführerin|als Beschwerdeführer)\s+([A-Z]{2,}(?:\.[A-Z])?)|(?:in der Beschwerdesache(?:\s+der)?|als Beschwerdeführerin|als Beschwerdeführer)\s+([A-Z][a-z]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-z]+)+)
